[EN] Test of the God

[EN] "I'm ready for this."
[ES] Estoy listo para esto.

[EN] Dragon's Soul Stone
[ES] Piedra del Alma de Dragón
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat Striktryssir in Saleron's Sky Garden and overcome Saleron's trial. [You must select Saleron's Sky Garden (Solo) from the {@LinkCreature:237#1501#Teleportal} to advance this quest.]
[ES] Derrota a Striktryssir en el Jardín Celestial de Saleron y supera la prueba de Saleron. [Debes seleccionar el Jardín Celestial de Saleron (Solitario) en el {@LinkCreature:237#1501#Teleportal} para avanzar en esta misión.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring the dragon's soul stone to Prophet Torsten and receive the relic fragment.
[ES] Llévale la piedra del alma de dragón al Profeta Torsten y recibe el fragmento de reliquia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Right. Okay."
[ES] "Bien. De acuerdo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The relic fragment's power is yours!
[ES] ¡El poder del fragmento de reliquia es tuyo!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring the relic fragment closer.
[ES] Acerca el fragmento de reliquia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] Gracias.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go back to the Ebon Span and speak with Saleron.
[ES] Regresa a Ebon Span y habla con Saleron.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
